title: Maximum site cover
text: C3.1.1 Development on each site does not exceed the maximum site cover percentages of Table 3.1a. Table 3.1a Maximum site cover: R2 and R2.5 25%; R5 35%; R10 45%; R12.5 50%; R15-R25 55%. Site cover does not apply to R30 and above.

replaces.note: open space minimum replaced by site cover maximum; +5 points at every code R2-R25
open space column inverted to site cover
grouped-dwelling site including its proportionate share of common property not carried (register ch3-043)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Site cover is tested against the grouped dwelling's own site: the land occupied by the dwelling plus all areas, contiguous or not, designated for the exclusive use of its occupants (Appendix A1 'site', register ch3-043; C4.1.2(i), p51, states the same basis for site area). Part B 5.1.4 C4 added the dwelling's proportionate share of common property; the draft does not, so a common driveway no longer dilutes the denominator (tightening, not in the Table of Changes). site.area_m2 and building.roofed_area_m2 are therefore the exclusive-use site and its roofed area for each dwelling; run the rule per dwelling or supply the worst dwelling. Basis confirmed on p28 and Appendix A1 (pass 1). R30 and above (and R100-SL) return NOT_APPLICABLE through the null table row (register ch3-042). +5 points at every code R2-R25 (register ch3-041).

verified.note: Values match p28. Site basis settled: C3.1.1 prints 'site' as a defined term, and Appendix A1 'site' (ii) for a grouped dwelling is the area occupied by the dwelling together with any area allocated (by strata scheme or otherwise) for its exclusive use or benefit; C4.1.2(i) (p51) uses the same basis. No share of common property.
